## Data Load and summary

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(performance)
library(patchwork)
library(emmeans)
library(ggeffects)
library(camerondata)

# Load the randhealth dataset
data(randhealth)




## Part 1: Research Question and Estimand
The question, the target population, the estimand as a population quantity, and why that estimand answers the question.

## Part 2: Sampling Mechanism
Eligibility, selection or assignment, measurement, and missingness, each from the dataset's documentation; the mechanism named in course terms; a statement of which estimands are reachable for which population; design variables identified if present.

```


## Fit model
```{r}
pois_mod <- glm(
  mdvis ~ coins + income + xage + female + educdec + black + offset(log(time)),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = subset(randhealth, time > 0)
)

nb_mod <- MASS::glm.nb(
  mdvis ~ coins + income + xage + female + educdec + black + offset(log(time)),
  data = subset(randhealth, time > 0)
)

summary(pois_mod)
summary(nb_mod)
```

```{r}

# TestZeroINFLATION PACKAGE

testZeroInflation(nb_model_camera)

#

obsZeros <- sum(nb_model_camera$model$cam_count==0)
numZeros <- rep(NA, 1000)
for(i in 1:1000){
numZeros[i] <- sum(simulate(nb_model_camera)==0)
}
1-mean(numZeros <= obsZeros)
```
